title: Insect-Like Behemoth
front_description: The giant creatures herded into the arena to do away with Padmé and her Jedi bodyguards are like something out of a nightmare. The reek and nexu are savage monster mammals that in many ways resemble a bull and a lion, respectively. Perhaps most unnverving of all is the screeching acklay,  a sort of weird hybrid of insect and reptile. It is Obi-Wan Kenobi who must take on this ferocious beast, with Jedi ingenuity his only weapon.
back_description: Robert Barnes' illustration of the Acklay, arguably the most grotesque arena monster.
